answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded escrow whose yield streams from a shared orchard of verified work, so fake accounts cannot harvest rewards without collateral. A cryptographic kernel hashes each agent's stake and reputation into a jade-sealed credential, making identity duplication detectable at registration and costly to sustain across epochs. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
